G53's reading 67, stated while reading P06's 50 add-step lines (windows as149_000 and as149_025, read whole with each line's how), before their rows are written; not an amendment. Under G4a, I class each line by the step it adds. (a) Steps P06's own statement and range already hold are specifications (S-SHOW). These are a charge withdrawn after a denial or a display check, tracing by the tool or by timing, competing accounts and corrections of who changed the work, teasing that goes on after an explanation, and separate judgments of a work, its placers and their intent. (b) Steps another element already states are specifications that name it (S-OTHER). Members who stop repairing, or turn to help, once told a change is planned are P05, whose statement says a planned change is repaired away until its keepers are told (Rainbow6-021, ainbowroad-015, halo-037, portugal-028, trees-023). An apology or an appeal to the changer is P07 (Rainbow6-021, transformers-010, trees-023). Sparing a neighbour's mark once its maker explains is P07 (asktransgender-014). After the close, recording and correcting accounts of who attacked are P22 and P18 (TransFlagPlace-013). (c) A step that puts attribution before or after an act no element or arrow states is an elaboration, paired with a second room's add-step line. There are four such orders. First, the charged or self-admitted member is answered with acceptance or forgiveness (argentina-021 with giivasunner-053; fullcommunism-059 with funhaus-057). Second, a corrected or disowned attribution comes between a charge against a neighbour, or a call to war on it, and peace between the rooms, so no attack follows (monalisaclan-024 with radiohead-063). Third, members check whether a change is planned or a display fault before they repair or blame (romania-025 with redpandas-024). Fourth, a proposal to sanction traced placers personally, by publishing their names or through their profiles, meets a rule or a refusal (polska-015 with serbia-040). Advice to report traced bots to the event's moderators shows in one add-step line only (rickandmorty-063: PART). (d) A visitor's own account with no member's answer is EL-VIS (PUBATTLEGROUNDS-018). A member's claim to have converted a rival's flag, checked by refreshing, and a threatened attack with no change yet, work out no change to the room's work (EL-NOT: anarcho_capitalism-013, elitedangerous-018).
